coordinate_space: Unpadded d1/p1 native actor pixels. Draw atlas rect [left,top,right,bottom) at actor xy. All image paths relative to this file.
composite: Start with the standing d1/p1 sprite, apply accepted left-hand erase. When original_rest=false also apply the turn rest_patch (destination-out erase, then restore). Draw accepted support back, current book with persistent ink, accepted support front, far working fingers, one loose pen, the loop lip when engaged, near working fingers, and the sleeve across the wrist. An original_rest frame uses the original right arm only. Do not draw a loose pen when stowed=true.
direct_transition: After turn/turn.json stages.turn[-1] choose turn_to_pen[1:] then write then return. The hand does not drop to its side between those activities. After standalone return, the small new inscription remains on the stowed page.

art_revision.scope: Existing 24fps 102-frame actor/pen clip. Fixed support hand is reused. Only the active sleeve deformation, finger placements/angle, loose-pen nib and per-frame free lift/pitch are revised.
art_revision.geometry: Angle and xy express the same actor-space hand as the previous schema. elbow_guide_actor_px is a check point halfway along the deformed shoulder-to-wrist sleeve curve, not a new runtime interpolation hook.
